text: Don't touch anything for 5 seconds.
Press and release Play on deck 1.
Press and release Cue on deck 1.
Press and release Sync on deck 1.
In Hot Cue mode, press and release pad 1 on deck 1.
In Hot Cue mode, press and release pad 2 on deck 1.
In Hot Cue mode, press and release pad 3 on deck 1.
In Hot Cue mode, press and release pad 4 on deck 1.
In Hot Cue mode, press and release pad 5 on deck 1.
In Hot Cue mode, press and release pad 6 on deck 1.
In Hot Cue mode, press and release pad 7 on deck 1.
In Hot Cue mode, press and release pad 8 on deck 1.
Move the pitch fader slowly all the way from the top to the bottom.
Touch the top of the jog wheel, turn it right a quarter turn, then left, then let go.
Without touching the top, spin the jog wheel's edge right, then left.
Touch the needle strip at the left, slide slowly to the right, then let go.
Press and release Loop In on deck 1.
Press and release Loop Out on deck 1.
Press and release Auto Loop on deck 1.
Turn the browse knob right three clicks, then left three clicks.
Press and release the browse knob.
Press and release Shift on deck 1.
Hold Shift, press and release Play, then let go of Shift.
Hold Shift, press and release Cue, then let go of Shift.
Hold Shift, press and release pad 1, then let go of Shift.
Switch the left side to deck 2 (its deck or layer button).
Press and release Play on deck 2.
